facts.value: Research Regulations 2026/27 govern PhD (including MBBS intercalated), MD(Res), and MPhil. MPhil is FHEQ level 7; PhD and MD(Res) level 8. They exclude MRes/taught integrated years and EngD, which has separate regulations. All programmes are conducted in English. MPhil may be a direct registered award or a transfer/exit award; it is not automatically a compulsory initial PhD degree.

applicant_categories: Applicants within the described degree, project, employment or funding scope
scope.cycle: 2026/27 regulations

facts.value: Normal PhD/MPhil entry: UK upper-second honours plus a Master, upper-second MSci/MEng, an appropriate registrable medical/Master qualification at FHEQ7, or an approved professional written-examination qualification; recognised overseas equivalents and English required. Individual course requirements may be higher. Below-grade applicants at the required qualification level may be considered with considerable compensating work experience through formal departmental/DPS/admissions approval. Previous withdrawal/failure normally precludes readmission to the same or closely related programme.

applicant_categories: Applicants within the described degree, project, employment or funding scope
scope.cycle: 2026/27 regulations; sections 4–6

facts.value: MD(Res) requires a medical qualification registrable in the UK and full or limited GMC registration. DPS may waive GMC registration for a special case whose research involves no patient contact. Loss of GMC registration can trigger continuation review.

applicant_categories: MD(Res) applicants; discretionary DPS GMC waiver requires research without patient contact
scope.cycle: 2026/27 regulations; paragraph 15

facts.value: Intercalated PhD during MBBS requires satisfactory completion of earlier MBBS years without examination resits and an upper-second or better BSc. This is an internal eligibility route, not direct school-leaver PhD admission.

applicant_categories: Current Imperial MBBS students seeking internal intercalated PhD progression after the specified MBBS and BSc stages
scope.cycle: 2026/27 regulations

facts.value: PhD/MD(Res) require research, thesis/viva, departmental training and at least four ECRI skills credits (two by ESA and two more by LSR), plagiarism training and Trusted Research e-learning for entrants from 1 September 2026. DACR diagnostic training applies to registrations from 1 September 2025 by ESA. ESA by 12 FT/24 PT months, LSR by 24/48, progress review by 36/72; failed progress may withdraw or transfer PhD to MPhil. MPhil requires at least two skills credits and plagiarism training before examination and its departmental reviews. These are completion/progression requirements, not entry tests.

applicant_categories: Applicants within the described degree, project, employment or funding scope
scope.cycle: 2026/27 regulations; pages 9–13

facts.value: Normally most research is at Imperial. Approved external research has minimum attendance 12 months PhD/MD(Res), six MPhil. Split PhD requires 12 months active Imperial attendance; PRI two months each academic year, excluding writing-up. Advanced-standing active minimum is 12 FT/24 PT months. Writing-up is separately approved, normally after 36/72 months; earlier entry normally cannot precede 24/48 active months.

applicant_categories: Applicants within the described degree, project, employment or funding scope
scope.cycle: 2026/27 regulations

facts.value: Relevant engineering, physical science, mathematics, biomedical/physiology/medical backgrounds; first/good upper-second subject to central qualifications. Contact supervisor; two academic references from institutional email; full transcripts; CV up to two pages and personal statement/research proposal up to two pages. Advertised studentships do not require a proposal. Interview in English normally 30–40 minutes with two staff, in person/telephone/video. Applications all year; funding often early November/January (yearless guidance). Decisions typically 8–10 weeks after complete submission; acceptance is not funding.

applicant_categories: Applicants within the described degree, project, employment or funding scope
scope.cycle: Current guidance reviewed 2026-10-01; no entry year inferred

facts.value: First-class undergraduate OR upper-second integrated Master OR upper-second Bachelor plus standalone Master; special cases discussed with admissions. Research spans engineering/physical/mathematical/biological/medical backgrounds. PhD four years FT. Intakes first working Monday of October, January, April, July. Two academic referees excluding proposed supervisor, complete documents before decision; online English interview at least 30 minutes with two staff; normally 10–12 weeks. Two-page statement plus proposal is specifically scholarship documentation. Published scholarship rounds 3 November 2025, 12 January 2026, 2 March 2026 at 23:59 UK apply to 2026/27, not silently 2027.

facts.value: MD(Res) is a two-year full-time research route for medically qualified applicants. Central MD(Res) medical/GMC requirements and documented waiver still apply; do not substitute PhD engineering qualifications.

facts.value: Three–four-year interdisciplinary research; Higher English. My Imperial application includes full transcripts, statement of research interest/experience, English evidence if applicable and two referees at least one academic. Scholarship panel interviews typically 20 minutes, technical/motivation questions, London in person otherwise Teams. Successful scholarship interviewees choose two supervisors/projects; sequential matching may fail. Self/external funding needs an agreed supervisor and independent interview. Departmental selection precedes College scholarships; yearless October31/December31/February28 rounds coexist with explicitly dated 2026-entry awards and cannot be assumed published 2027 awards.

facts.value: Multidisciplinary engineering, physical/life/social science research. Prior supervisor interest required before online application; funding also needs supervisor nomination by the same departmental deadline. Current scholarship rounds 2 November 2026, 11 January 2027, 1 March 2027, 1 June 2027; table assigns schemes to particular rounds, not all four for all schemes. No funding visa/IHS unless specified. Department page still says earliest start August–October 2026 despite 2027 deadlines: unresolved date conflict. See source FAQ for qualification/document details; no invented qualification waiver or English level.

facts.value: Normally first-class/Distinction Master in relevant scientific/technical discipline; undergraduate normally UK2:1 equivalent. Bachelor-only normally not considered, but outstanding applicants or extensive relevant industry/research experience may formally apply with evidence of compensating factors; exceptions cannot be pre-assessed by email. Standard English. CV with linked publications, all Bachelor/Master transcripts, two references, personal statement1–2 pages and original literature-referenced research statement3–4 pages; statements written by applicant without GenAI. Suggest3–4 supervisors; normal review only after formal application. Interview may present past project or discuss assigned papers. General degree target differs from AI4Health target. April/October2027 rounds:1 October2026,1 December2026,1 February2027,1 April2027 with decisions15 February/15 April/15 June/15 July2027; no exact deadline time published.

facts.value: Relevant upper-second Master in engineering/design/science; Bachelor-only may be considered with significant relevant industry/research experience. Named willing supervisor and research topic required. CV, degrees/transcripts, two references, English evidence, personal/research statement1–2 pages. English interview with two staff and optional DPS, presentation up to20 minutes on skills/projects. Source contains older COVID remote-only statement and 2020 nationality ATAS guidance; these are not treated as confirmed current mode/exemptions.
